search.title: Search service
search.description: User-level search service: the default backend for every search node. Keys are bound per source — switching providers never loses or cross-assigns another source's key. Node-level config wins over this; env vars are the last fallback.
search.apiKeyPlaceholder: Empty falls back to node config / env var
search.cxDescription: Google only: create one at cse.google.com.
search.note: Each source keeps its own key independently; takes effect on the next run without a restart; keys are encrypted at rest.

mcp.title: MCP servers
mcp.description: Connect third-party MCP servers and mount the tools they expose onto pipeline nodes. Remote transports only (http / sse): stdio takes a local spawn command, which is arbitrary code execution, so it stays operator-only via env vars.
mcp.empty: No MCP servers yet. Add one below.
mcp.name: Name
mcp.authHeaderHint: Some servers want a bearer token; leave empty to send no auth header. A saved value comes back masked — leave it alone to keep it.
mcp.note: Credentials are encrypted at rest. Nothing reconnects on its own — after editing an endpoint or key, hit Save and connect. Tool ids look like mcp:<server>:<tool>; a built-in skill of the same id always wins.
mcp.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, ID, or URL…

cards.title: Your own skill cards
cards.description: Cards you author yourself, visible only on your own pipelines. All three kinds are plain data — a prompt fragment, a judging clause, a field table — so no sandbox is needed.
cards.name: Name
cards.promptPlaceholder: Appended to the node's system prompt
cards.criterionPlaceholder: What a gate node judges against
cards.note: Ids get a local: prefix automatically; a built-in skill with the same id always wins, so a card can never shadow one. Takes effect on the next run.
